cc:Work.dc:title: Two B200 GPUs · Qwen3.8-Flash-Next BF16
cc:Work.dc:description: Stock SGLang AR, stock vLLM AR, stock SGLang MTP3, stock vLLM MTP3 and AX Engine MTP7 at concurrency 1, 4 and 16. Stock vLLM MTP3 leads at C4 and C16; AX MTP7 leads code and math at C1.
